name: ad-director-mcp
description: Interactive Storyboard & Ad Director MCP Server with DAG story branching, studio UI, and multi-preset narrative frameworks.

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/ui', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/ui/studio-app.html', 'dist/ui/studio-app.html'); try { fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755); fs.chmodSync('dist/index.js', 0o755); } catch(e){}"
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/run-verification.mjs && node tests/test-architecture-and-fixes.mjs && node tests/test-cli.mjs && node tests/test-stdio.mjs && node tests/test-system32-cwd.mjs

author: Antigravity Team
